description: Demolition of existing office building and erection of part five storey and part four storey office building with associated parking spaces
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The demolition of existing office building and erection of a part five storey and part four storey office building with associated parking spaces, as shown on drawing nos. 3561 ARCH P1001 E, 3561 ARCH P1002 F, 3561 ARCH P1003 E, 3561 ARCH P1004 D, 3561 ARCH P1005 E, 3561 ARCH P1006 D, 3561 ARCH P1007 D, 3561 ARCH 1008 C (Amended plans) all received 8 February 2006 and Transport Statement by Savell Bird & Axon dated November 2005, would maintain and enhance the existing employment use at a site within a designated development node and a sustainable location. Therefore the proposal complies with the sustainability objectives and employment and transport policies of the London Plan and the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003, and would it not unduly alter the setting of the adjacent locally listed building or reduce the amenity of neighbouring and surrounding properties.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - Detailed drawings of the eastern elevation and roof top safety railings/ balustrade shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 6 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0730  to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800  to 1700 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 10 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking and cycle spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing no. 3561 ARCH P1001 E received 8 February 2006, and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
